description: This file defines a Prometheus metrics provider class for monitoring an application, including setting up counters, histograms, and an endpoint for metrics collection.

classes.name: Prometheus
classes.description: A class implementing IMetricsProvider to collect and expose application metrics using Prometheus.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metrics provider, 'Prometheus'.

methods.name: initializeCounters
methods.description: Initializes various counters and histograms for metrics collection, and sets up the metrics endpoint.

methods.name: setupMetricsEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the Express app to serve metrics at '/api/v1/metrics' and tracks request durations.

methods.name: incrementCounter
methods.description: Increments a specified counter with a given payload.

methods.name: registerMetrics
methods.description: Registers custom metrics and enables default metrics collection if configured.
